posts.title: I have a machine learning engineer in my pocket
posts.description: I built an iPhone keyboard trained on eight years of my own writing without writing a line of its code. Coding agents still work on it regularly.

posts.title: Stop Letting AI Companies Monetize Your Memories
posts.description: Every model I use reads from and writes to one knowledge graph on my own server, so my context follows me across Claude, GPT, Gemini and the rest.
